pair_note: Observed-only predecessor pair; physical ordering valid. Second consecutive non-zero post-reanchor pair shows boundary idle dominating tens-of-seconds useful work.

decision.reason: The observed predecessor pair was 32s useful work versus 550s idle (5.50% utilization). This reinforces that voluntary handoff after only tens of seconds is dominated while safe useful work remains. No jitter mechanism was changed; only same-wake useful-work duration remains the experimental variable. Continuation was secured before durable-state write.

measurement_guard.rule: work_end_time must be an observed completed-work timestamp at or before the state write; active_work_sec must represent completed useful work only
measurement_guard.purpose: prevent projected durations from being misclassified as runtime-frontier evidence
